messages:
maria: Quick sync — need to finalize staged-gates + launch criteria for the new Inference Efficiency Advisor (IEA). Goal: give customers actionable batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts without surprise regressions.

akshay: +1. can we define MVP scope tight? I want something we can push in 2 sprints.

sasha: MVP suggestion: 1) per-route batching guidance (heuristics + simulation), 2) prefix/KV cache enable hint + TTL recommendation, 3) model quantization profile recommendations (int8/4bit suggestions), 4) eval-alert alpha that fires on large drift on a small golden set. keep alert noisy low.

li: customers keep asking for tenant-level cache controls and a simple UI snippet they can paste. for pilots we should include a one-click enable link and a short diagnostics link.

evans: (from product) propose staged gates: INTERNAL -> BETA CUSTOMERS (3) -> CANARY (5% traffic) -> GA. Launch criteria per stage below.

maria: draft launch gates/criteria from my side:
- INTERNAL: feature flagged, end-to-end pipeline + basic UI, test coverage for heuristics.
- BETA: 3 pilot customers onboarded, documented runbook, p95 latency regression <= 10% on pilot workloads, measured cost delta reported.
- CANARY: telemetry for token-level cost, cache hit rates, quant impact; automatic rollback on errors.
- GA: >3 months of pilot data, customer-facing docs, SLAs for Dedicated tenants.

akshay: engineering constraints: quantization recs need model metadata + offline profiling. we can ship heuristics without full profiling but need clear labeling: "recommendation based on heuristic" vs "profile-backed". also batching suggestions require per-route token-length histograms.

sasha: eval-alert design: small default golden set (10-20 prompts) + compare response embeddings / similarity + token-level perplexity change. thresholding: start with conservative thresholds to avoid false positives. also add a "quiet window" to suppress duplicate alerts.

li: onboarding ask: customer-facing partial rollback controls (disable quant recs, disable batching suggestions). they want ability to opt-out per-route.

evans: metrics we must instrument before BETA: cache_hit_rate, batching_gain_estimate, token_cost_delta, eval_alert_fp_rate. Need dashboards.

akshay: ops question: do we want this tied into existing rollouts/flags? we can reuse the rollout service. deploy-bot: feature-flag-service already supports percentage rollouts and per-org targeting — use feature key `iea_v1` and flags: `iea_batching`, `iea_cache`, `iea_quant`, `iea_eval_alerts`.

maria: nice. for acceptance we should set quantitative thresholds for pilot pass:
- measurable cost savings >= 10% on at least one high-traffic route OR no customer latency worsening > 5%
- eval-alert false positive rate < 5% over pilot window
- docs + runbook + customer playbook written

sasha: small caveat — cost saving estimates are workload dependent. suggest we require a documented expected range and at least one customer-observed improvement, not a blanket percent for all customers.

li: customer asks to see recommended quant profiles per model family (e.g., Llama2-ish vs Mistral-ish). product should include mapping table in docs.

akshay: implementation note: for quant recs we need to store one sample profile per model variant in metadata store. collect offline runner outputs + latency/cost deltas. this means a separate profiling job; can be async for GA.

evans: timeline proposal: 2 sprints to get INTERNAL working (core infra + flag + simple UI), 3rd sprint onboard 2 internal teams + initial pilot outreach, sprint 5 run BETA pilots. tight but doable if eng prioritizes.

maria: priorities for MVP (final): 1) batching guidance + simulation, 2) cache TTL + per-route opt-out, 3) quant rec heuristics + labeling, 4) eval-alert alpha with conservative thresholds, 5) dashboard + telemetry hooks. anything else?

sasha: add minimal evaluation harness to record golden-set diffs and auto-attach examples to alerts. makes triage easier.

li: sales/solutions wants a short checklist for pilots — I'll draft and share.

akshay: blocking risks: profiling infra for quant, sampling overhead for collecting histograms, and noisy alerts. let's add acceptance tests to block noisy alerts.

evans: decision: go ahead with staged plan + feature flags. owners: maria (product), akshay (eng runtime), sasha (ml/evals), li (solutions). I'll put in roadmap doc.

maria: thanks — I'll convert this into a one-pager with the gates and criteria, plus a pilot checklist. can everyone review in #product by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: created feature flag `iea_v1` with subflags at 2026-03-21T15:04:01Z. Use `--flag iea_v1` in local dev to opt-in.
